# The Next Founder

> The Next Founder is a platform and TV format by House of Founders. Ventures that were thought up, built and tested at House of Founders look for a founder to run them; partners fund the first phase in tranches released per milestone. Candidates apply in a video conversation with Eva, an AI interviewer, get a score and feedback, and the best pitch on the show, where investors compete for the founder.

The site is in Dutch (default) and English. Seven ventures come from House of Founders; ten are examples for the prototype. Tranche amounts are examples. The app is a scripted prototype.

- [Zonde](/en/ventures/zonde/): Helps households once their solar panels stop paying off.
- [Biedmeester](/en/ventures/biedmeester/): An AI that watches, explains and adjusts the Google Ads of several clients.
- [Vaste Prik](/en/ventures/vaste-prik/): Digital loyalty cards in Apple and Google Wallet, no app needed.

- [Klusbieb](/en/ventures/klusbieb/): Borrow tools from your neighbours, by the day. (example)
- [Oogstrijk](/en/ventures/oogstrijk/): Farm surplus straight to restaurants. (example)
- [Stille Uren](/en/ventures/stille-uren/): Book a quiet seat in a café, by the hour. (example)
- [Kinderkast](/en/ventures/kinderkast/): A clothing subscription for kids, second hand and growing with them. (example)
- [Pensioenpraat](/en/ventures/pensioenpraat/): Explains to freelancers in five minutes what to do about their pension. (example)
- [Beweegmaatje](/en/ventures/beweegmaatje/): Matches older people with a walking buddy nearby. (example)

## Exit Buddy

Finds the right adviser for selling your business. Needs: commercial. Milestones: Twenty owners who want to sell in conversation; The first three paid engagements; Ten advisers under contract.

## APK Opa

Retired mechanics inspect a used car before you buy it. Needs: commercial. Milestones: Ten retired mechanics on board; The first fifty inspections in one region; A second region open.

## Whoop Dog

A tracker that measures how your dog sleeps and recovers. Needs: technical. Milestones: A working prototype on fifteen dogs; Crowdfunding campaign live; Manufacturing partner chosen.

## Eitje

A fertility check for women. Needs: technical and commercial. Milestones: Medical partner lab chosen; A waiting list of five hundred women; The first paid checks.

## Zonde

Helps households once their solar panels stop paying off. Needs: commercial. Milestones: Fifty leads from households with panels; The first installer as partner; Twenty households helped.

## Biedmeester

An AI that watches, explains and adjusts the Google Ads of several clients. Needs: commercial. Milestones: Five paying agencies; Company and IP deed in place; Twenty paying agencies.

## Vaste Prik

Digital loyalty cards in Apple and Google Wallet, no app needed. Needs: commercial. Milestones: Ten paying businesses; A till system as sales partner; A hundred businesses live.

## Fietsdokter

A bike mechanic who comes to your home or office, on subscription. Needs: commercial. Milestones: A hundred subscribers in one city; Three companies on a team plan; A second mechanic at work.

## Klusbieb

Borrow tools from your neighbours, by the day. Needs: technical and commercial. Milestones: Two hundred tools listed; Five hundred loans; A second neighbourhood live.

## Oogstrijk

Farm surplus straight to restaurants. Needs: commercial. Milestones: Ten farmers on board; Twenty restaurants ordering weekly; Own delivery route profitable.

## Stille Uren

Book a quiet seat in a café, by the hour. Needs: technical and commercial. Milestones: Fifteen cafés on board; A thousand hours booked; A plan for companies.

## Kinderkast

A clothing subscription for kids, second hand and growing with them. Needs: commercial. Milestones: Three hundred active subscriptions; Returns under two days; A thousand active subscriptions.

## Pensioenpraat

Explains to freelancers in five minutes what to do about their pension. Needs: technical and commercial. Milestones: A waiting list of a thousand freelancers; A pension partner on paper; The first paying users.

## Beweegmaatje

Matches older people with a walking buddy nearby. Needs: commercial. Milestones: Fifty pairs in one municipality; A municipality as client; Three municipalities.

## Bouwlog

A digital site diary for contractors, dictated on site. Needs: technical. Milestones: Ten contractors in a pilot; Integration with an accounting package; Fifty paying contractors.

## Zorgrooster

An AI that builds rosters for home care. Needs: technical. Milestones: A pilot with one home care team; Rosters in half the time; Three organisations paying.

## Bakdeel

Share a cargo bike with your street. Needs: commercial. Milestones: Ten streets with a cargo bike; A housing association as partner; A hundred streets.
